description: Versioned rubric (S2-006 spec section 7): for every class a definition, examples, counterexamples, the allowed ambiguity and the abstention rule. Entailment holds only for the exact statement with its polarity, quantities, units, population, geography, period and modality; topic overlap is not entailment; scope differences, missing data and independent claims are not contradictions; analogy, temporal co-occurrence and correlation never prove mechanism; PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED never auto-converts to support.
title: Veritas Rubric (S2-006)

ambiguityRule.description: How admissible ambiguity is decided for this class; unresolvable ambiguity falls back to the abstention rule.

abstentionRule.description: When the annotator/verifier must abstain (e.g. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) instead of guessing.
